name: Conversation
summary: Root container for an AI chat thread. Manages scroll behavior, virtualization for long threads (TanStack Virtual at >100 messages), auto-scroll-to-bottom on new messages, and an empty state. Wraps every Message in the family. Mirrors Vercel AI Elements `Conversation` verbatim.

messages.description: Pass child `<Message>` components OR render via render-prop. When passed as children, Conversation auto-wraps in ConversationContent.

autoScroll.description: Auto-scroll to the latest message when a new one arrives. Disable for read-only thread review surfaces.

virtualizeAfter.description: Threshold above which the thread switches to TanStack Virtual rendering. Below this, all messages are mounted simultaneously for smooth in-thread navigation.

className.description: Pass-through for layout overrides. The internal scroll container handles its own padding + overflow.

keyboardSupport: Home — scroll to top of thread
End — scroll to bottom of thread (latest message)
a11y.screenReader: Each new assistant message is announced via aria-live=polite. The user's own messages are not re-announced (they typed them).
a11y.reducedMotion: Auto-scroll uses scroll-behavior: auto when prefers-reduced-motion is set (no smooth-scroll animation).

never: NEVER hardcode a model name inside Conversation. The model is a property of PromptInputSelect or LumenAIProvider context, not the thread renderer.
NEVER apply backdrop-filter to the thread container — it's a dense surface. Hard rule 16.
NEVER drop the ConversationScrollButton when the user scrolls up. It's the affordance back to live.
NEVER assume streaming is complete on any given render — child MessageResponse may still be partial.
always: ALWAYS pair with ConversationContent (or let Conversation auto-wrap children).
ALWAYS forward aria-live updates to assistive tech for new assistant messages.
ALWAYS honor prefers-reduced-motion in the auto-scroll behavior.
